description: Reopen r-sort-3-corpus-mdb (MDB) read-only. Table-type recordsets walk to the end reading ID: T with no Index (storage order), T by IX_K forward and backward, by IX_KD forward, the incrementally built T2 by IX_K and IX_KD, U with no Index and by IX_K forward and backward, and C by IX_KC and IX_KN. Asks the physical index traversal order, tie order and Null placement, separate from SQL ordering.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
